|game_text=If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, return that character to the same site from your Lost Pile and deploy this card on him or her. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3; it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints it (so does the Master List slip). The original text is reconstructed (see [[Field Dressing]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Field Dressing]], '''reconstructed'''): first printing, Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010). No copy of it survives: the surviving sheet was re-made on 28 July 2010, after the errata. The Players Committee news post “Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes” gives the errata text (PC-E1) and explains it: “Errata to Field Dressing — To reduce confusion about the interaction with First Aid and to clarify further what 'remains' actually meant.”<ref name="src-S4" /> The post does not quote the old text, so the original is rebuilt from that explanation (Bill, 10 November 2026) as PC-E1 without “and, if 'hit,' is restored to normal”: “If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, deploy on that character (who remains at same site). Character is forfeit = 0 (even if forfeit may not normally be reduced). May play First Aid to place this card in Used Pile. Immune to your Control.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Field Dressing (Errata)]]): errata announced 23 July 2010, effective 26 July 2010<ref name="src-S4">Players Committee news post "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes", 23 July 2010 (effective 26 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>; the PC website card list shows the same text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-VBlock7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]</ref>: “If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, deploy on that character (who remains at same site and, if 'hit,' is restored to normal). Character is forfeit = 0 (even if forfeit may not normally be reduced). May play First Aid to place this card in Used Pile. Immune to your Control.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-03-Field_Dressing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Field Dressing (Errata 2)]]): the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet as re-made 28 July 2010 (header still “Official text as of June 18, 2010”) adds “its” (“even if its forfeit may not normally be reduced”)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, deploy on that character (who remains at same site and, if ‘hit,’ is restored to normal). Character is forfeit = 0 (even if its forfeit may not normally be reduced). May play First Aid to place this card in Used Pile. Immune to your Control.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Field_Dressing.png]], errata mark E) prints it.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 24) returns the character from the Lost Pile instead<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, return that character to the same site from your Lost Pile and deploy this card on him or her. Character is forfeit = 0 (even if forfeit may not be normally reduced). May play First Aid to place this card in Used Pile. Immune to your Control.” The Master List slip and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-fielddressing-pre.gif]]) print it. The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 26 August 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook (the post strikes all earlier Field Dressing rules entries)<ref name="pcforum-p644156">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 26 August 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p644156 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
